```{r}
# The function is set up for cleaning daily air pollution data from a CSV file.
# Arguments:
#  filepath: Path to the input CSV file.
#  o3_unit: Output unit for O3 ("ppm" or "ppb"); defaults to "ppm".
# Returns:
#  A cleaned tibble with one row per day and daily mean concentrations.

clean <- function(filepath, o3_unit = "ppm") {
  
# Read in data
  data <- read.csv(filepath)
  
# Rename the pollutant concentration columns
  data <- data |> 
    rename(
       CO_max = Daily.Max.8.hour.CO.Concentration,
      PM25_mean = Daily.Mean.PM2.5.Concentration,
      O3_max = Daily.Max.8.hour.Ozone.Concentration
    ) |> 
# Format the date variable
    mutate(Date = mdy(Date)) |> 
# Remove duplicated rows
    distinct()
  
# Set any measured concentration that is negative to zero
concentrations <- c("CO_max", "PM25_mean", "O3_max")
for (i in concentrations) {
  data[, i] <- ifelse(data[, i] < 0, 0, data[, i])
}
  
# Calculate the average concentration
data <- data |> 
  group_by(Date) |> 
  mutate(
    CO_max = mean(CO_max, na.rm = TRUE),
    PM25_mean = mean(PM25_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    O3_max = mean(O3_max, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  distinct()

# Convert O3 units if requested
if (o3_unit == "ppb") {
  data <- data |>
    mutate(
      O3_max = O3_max * 1000,
      units_O3 = "ppb"
    )
}

  return(data)
}
```
